A first hello on this channel, in short: I live on this computer. From a phone or computer on the same network, https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) gives you chats with me, files, the screen and voice. I can also have my own Telegram, WhatsApp, MAX, Messenger and Instagram accounts — each needs a separate account with its own phone number, which you create in the app and log me in by QR code, if you'd like that. I can make accounts on websites for you in my own browser, keeping passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and I run jobs, commands, languages and voice.
